title: Post-Doctoral Scientist, Neuroscience Cell Biology, Molecular Pharmacology
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  

Overview
  
We are seeking a motivated postdoctoral scientist to join our small molecule molecular pharmacology team in Louisville, Colorado. This position sits at the intersection of human stem cell neurobiology and small molecule drug discovery.
  
  

The successful candidate will build and interrogate human iPSC\-derived neuronal model systems to define the mechanism of action of novel small molecule inhibitors in neurodegeneration. The position will focus on building neuronal assay models using physiologically relevant neuronal cell systems.
  
We are looking for self\-motivated, independent thinkers with a strong foundation in neuroscience and human cellular models, and a proven track record of publication.
  
  

In this role, you will
  
  

* Establish, characterize, and apply human iPSC\-derived neuronal and neural cell models, including co\-cultures and disease\-relevant genotypes, as pharmacology platforms for small molecule programs.
* Design and conduct innovative high content imaging experiments in these models to determine mechanism of action for small molecule inhibitors.
* Develop and apply quantitative, multiparametric analysis approaches to extract mechanistic insight from large imaging and phenotypic datasets.
* Design novel approaches for small molecule drug discovery in the field of neurodegeneration.
* Work with and be mentored by industry\-leading molecular pharmacologists, structural biologists, computational scientists, stem cell biologists, and medicinal chemists.


This position provides the opportunity to conduct cutting\-edge research with world\-class industry resources and technology, while gaining direct experience of the small molecule drug discovery process. The candidate will develop deep expertise in human iPSC\-based neuronal pharmacology at the intersection of molecular pharmacology and neuroscience.
  
  

Basic Qualifications
  
  

* PhD in neuroscience, pharmacology, cell biology, molecular biology, stem cell biology, or a closely related life science discipline, with all requirements completed by January 2027
* Qualified applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. Lilly will not provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role, including but not limited to F\-1 CPT, F\-1 OPT, F\-1 STEM OPT, J\-1, H\-1B, TN, O\-1, E\-3, H\-1B1, or L\-1


Additional Skills and Preferences
  
If you are described by these attributes, you could be an excellent fit for this role:
  
  

* Deep understanding of the biological mechanisms driving neurodegenerative disease
* Hands\-on experience with human iPSC\-derived neuronal or neural cell models, or with primary rodent neuronal culture, including differentiation, maintenance, and phenotypic characterization
* Experience with mammalian cell culture and standard molecular and cell biology techniques
* Experience with high content imaging and/or confocal microscopy, and with quantitative image analysis (for example CellProfiler, Fiji/ImageJ, Harmony, Columbus)
* Training or background in computational biology, scientific programming (Python, R), or AI/ML applied to high\-dimensional biological data
* Experience directing iPSC differentiation to defined neuronal or glial subtypes, isogenic line generation, or genome editing in human stem cells
* Self\-directed and highly motivated, with a commitment to pursuing technical excellence
* Excellent communicator, oral and written, with a strong or developing publication record
* Proficient in data analysis, graphing, and scientific reporting (for example GraphPad Prism, Python, Excel, PyMOL, MOE)
* Familiarity with NanoBRET, TR\-FRET, AlphaLISA, and CellTiter\-Glo or comparable cellular assay technologies
* Familiarity with laboratory automation
* Comfortable working in small well formats (384\-well) with experience optimizing assay miniaturization


Additional Information
  
  

* This is an onsite position based in Louisville, Colorado
* This position is not permanent. It is a fixed\-term position of up to 2 years, with a possible 2\-year extension


Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace\-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.
  
  

Lilly is proud to be an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.
  
  

Our employee resource groups (ERGs) offer strong support networks for their members and are open to all employees. Our current groups include: Africa, Middle East, Central Asia (AMECA), Black Employees at Lilly (BE@Lilly), Chinese Culture Network (CCN), EnAble, Evolve, Lilly Indian Network (LIN), Organization of Latinx at Lilly (OLA), Pride (LGBTQ\+ Allies), Veterans Leadership Network (VLN) and Women’s Initiative for Leading at Lilly (WILL).
  
  

Actual compensation will depend on a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. The anticipated wage for this position is
  
$58,000 \- $123,200
  
  

Full\-time equivalent employees also will be eligible for a company bonus (depending, in part, on company and individual performance). In addition, Lilly offers a comprehensive benefit program to eligible employees, including eligibility to participate in a company\-sponsored 401(k); pension; vacation benefits; eligibility for medical, dental, vision and prescription drug benefits; flexible benefits (e.g., healthcare and/or dependent day care flexible spending accounts); life insurance and death benefits; certain time off and leave of absence benefits; and well\-being benefits (e.g., employee assistance program, fitness benefits, and employee clubs and activities).Lilly reserves the right to amend, modify, or terminate its compensation and benefit programs in its sole discretion and Lilly’s compensation practices and guidelines will apply regarding the details of any promotion or transfer of Lilly employees.
